summary: Verified Dashboard fix (DashboardDrillDown returns null) and new Custom Date Range toggle (3M/6M/12M). Dashboard compiles and renders after admin login with no console/page errors. Range toggle group and 3M/6M/12M buttons present with correct data-testids. 6M is selected by default. Toggling changes bar counts correctly (3->3, 6->6, 12->12 in both Monthly Sales & Monthly Production) and subtitles update to 'last N months'. Top Customers bar click opens Sales Orders modal for that customer. Monthly Sales & Monthly Production drill-down modals could NOT be opened because the current seed data has zero delivery challans and zero completed job cards in every month (all bars are disabled by design: onBarClick disabled when value===0). The drill-down code path is verified to render nothing when drill is null (no stray dialog on load) and to open the correct Modal for the customer case, so the type-safety fix works.

integration_issues.issue: Could not exercise DC# and JC# modal columns because seed data has 0 delivery challans and 0 completed job cards in every month for last 12 months, so all bars are disabled. Code path is present and correct; needs seed data with recent completed challans/job cards to be verifiable end-to-end.

issues: When all values are 0, the numeric '0' labels overlap the tiny disabled bars; consider hiding the '0' label when value is zero or shifting it above the bar for readability.

action_items: Optional: seed a few delivery challans and completed job cards in the last 3-6 months so the Monthly Sales / Monthly Production drill-down modals are testable and useful for demo users.
Optional design: suppress '0' bar-value labels or improve label placement in ProductionBarChart when value === 0 (12M view is crowded).
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.tsx is 760 lines and contains multiple components (DashboardDrillDown, ProductionBarChart, DelayedDeliveries, etc.). Consider splitting into /pages/Dashboard/ subfolder for maintainability (>700-line threshold).
DashboardDrillDown receives monthBuckets but the customer branch does `void monthBuckets` — the prop is unused for that branch; consider making it optional or removing to avoid confusion.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for items testable with current seed data

context_for_next_testing_agent: Dashboard range toggle verified (3M/6M/12M). Drill-down for customer verified. Sales & Production drill-downs blocked only by absence of seed data (all months = 0). If main agent adds seed challans/jobcards, re-verify by clicking a non-zero Monthly Sales bar (expect Modal 'Delivery Challans · <Month>' with columns DC #, Date, Customer, SO #, Qty, Amount) and Monthly Production bar (Modal 'Completed Job Cards · <Month>' with JC #, Date, Product, Qty, Linked SO).
rca of the issue: Original TypeScript error: DashboardDrillDown returned <Modal open={false} ...></Modal> without required children prop when drill was null. Fix (return null) is correct — verified: no compile errors, dashboard mounts cleanly, no stray dialog rendered on load.
